preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The number of elements in each sequence is between 4 and 100000, inclusive.
Each element of the sequence is an integer with absolute value less than or equal to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500000
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all sequences does not exceed 500000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(is_arithmetic_sequence(line.split(), d) for line, d in zip(output, differences))
postconditions.description: Each line represents an arithmetic sequence with a common difference d, which may differ from the original sequence in at most one position.
